fields.Name: IT13 - API Keys Engine Authorize
fields.Description: Exercises the API Keys engine end-to-end against real seeded metadata (deterministic, in-process — no model calls). AK1: Config() loads the real seeded API Scopes (full_access, entity:read, entity:delete, agent:execute). AK2: Config() loads the real seeded API Applications (MJAPI). AK3: a real key with an explicit ALLOW rule (entity:read) and an explicit DENY rule (entity:delete) authorizes/denies correctly through Authorize() — then is cleaned up (key + scope rules + usage logs). AK3 creates and tears down its own fixtures inside the check.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Seeded scopes + applications load via Config(); a real key's explicit allow/deny rules are honored by Authorize().
